threats.threat_description: An attacker captures and replays the key fob's RF response messages to the vehicle RF transceiver to gain unauthorized access or start the engine without possessing the physical key fob.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity and Confidentiality of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and engine starting.

threats.threat_description: Compromise or extraction of cryptographic keys or firmware from the key fob, which could allow cloning or impersonation of the key fob.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0028: Hardware Fault Injection to prevent unauthorized vehicle access and operation.

threats.threat_description: Jamming or blocking the RF communication channel between the key fob and vehicle RF antenna to prevent authentication and lock/unlock operations.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall ensure the Availability of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent loss of remote lock/unlock and keyless entry/start functionality.

threats.threat_description: An attacker transmits false LF proximity signals to the LF antenna to trigger unauthorized wake events and cause the vehicle BCM to initiate challenge-response flows without a legitimate key fob nearby.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of LF Proximity Signal against Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unauthorized BCM wake events and reduce exposure to further relay or brute-force attacks.

threats.threat_description: Interference or jamming of the LF antenna signals prevents the detection of the legitimate key fob's proximity, denying the user access or start functionality.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of the LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized denial of vehicle access or start functionality.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering with the vehicle RF antenna (e.g., antenna replacement or modification) to enable relay attacks, signal amplification, or unauthorized interception of RF messages.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Physical Inspection / Penetration Testing / RF Signal Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker eavesdrops on the RF communication channel at the antenna to obtain sensitive challenge-response messages for offline analysis or replay attempts.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle access via replay or offline cryptanalysis attacks.

threats.threat_description: Compromise of the RF transceiver's firmware allows an attacker to modify or forge authentication data forwarded to the BCM, potentially enabling unauthorized access.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of RF Challenge-Response Messages and Firmware against Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry and theft.

threats.threat_description: Leakage of authentication data or key identifiers through compromised RF transceiver firmware or side channels.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of RF Transceiver Firmware and Authentication Data against ATM-T0040: Unsecured Credentials to prevent unauthorized access to vehicle systems via impersonation or replay attacks.

threats.threat_description: An attacker disrupts the RF transceiver operation or its forwarding function, preventing legitimate RF responses from reaching the BCM and denying entry/start functions.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of legitimate vehicle entry and start functions.

threats.threat_description: An attacker impersonates the BCM on the CAN bus by forging lock/unlock or start authorization commands with stolen tokens or replayed messages to control door or engine functions.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of CAN Lock/Unlock Message, Start Authorization Token, Door Lock/Unlock Command, and Engine Start Command against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry, starting, and use.

threats.threat_description: Unauthorized modification of BCM firmware or configuration data could allow bypassing authentication checks or manipulation of challenge-response logic.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Firmware and Configuration Data against Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent persistent compromise of authentication routines and unauthorized vehicle entry or operation.

threats.threat_description: Insufficient logging or audit data in BCM may allow attackers to deny performing unauthorized unlock or start commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, and Accountability of BCM Configuration and Access Policies against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent undetected and untraceable unauthorized unlock or start commands.

threats.threat_description: Sensitive cryptographic keys, tokens, or configuration data stored or processed in the BCM may be exposed through side channels or software vulnerabilities.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Start Authorization Token and BCM Configuration and Access Policies against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle start and manipulation of BCM access policies.

threats.threat_description: An attacker floods the BCM with false LF wake signals or malformed messages to exhaust its resources or prevent legitimate authentication flows.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF Proximity Signal and BCM Configuration and Access Policies against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent authorized users from being unable to unlock or start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: A compromised or malicious BCM firmware could invoke HSM operations with unauthorized parameters, bypassing access controls and generating tokens for unauthorized operations.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of the Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized cryptographic operations and compromise of vehicle security functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Interface Access Control Review

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects forged unlock/lock commands with valid tokens on the CAN bus to the Door ECU, causing unauthorized door access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of CAN Lock/Unlock Messages and Door Lock/Unlock Commands against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized door access or denial of entry.

threats.threat_description: Modification of Door ECU firmware or configuration could allow bypassing authorization checks or manipulation of door actuator signals.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of its Firmware and Configuration against Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized manipulation of door actuator signals and bypass of authorization checks.

threats.threat_description: An attacker disrupts communication between BCM and Door ECU, or disables the Door ECU to prevent locking or unlocking of doors.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of CAN Lock/Unlock Message and Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent vehicle occupants from being unable to secure or access the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: An attacker forges start authorization tokens or commands on the CAN bus to the Start Authorization ECU to enable engine start without valid authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of the Powertrain Start Interface and Engine Start Command against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Modification of Start Authorization ECU firmware or configuration could bypass token verification and allow unauthorized engine start.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of Firmware in BCM against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Disruption or blocking of start authorization messages prevents legitimate engine start commands from being executed.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of the Powertrain Start Interface and Engine Start Command against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized immobilization of the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Firmware compromise or manipulation of the HSM could lead to unauthorized key extraction, bypassing of cryptographic verification, or generation of invalid authorization tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Integrity, Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Availability of HSM Firmware, Secure Boot Measurements, Cryptographic Key Material, and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0023: Modify Isolated Execution Environment to prevent unauthorized vehicle start, key extraction, and disabling of security features.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Integrity Verification / Interface Analysis

threats.threat_description: Leakage of cryptographic keys or tokens stored within the HSM through side channels or fault injection attacks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Cryptographic Key Material and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0028: Hardware Fault Injection to prevent unauthorized vehicle starting, theft, and compromise of secure communications.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Side-Channel and Fault Injection Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker causes the HSM to become unresponsive or fail to provide cryptographic verification, blocking authentication flows or token issuance.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of the Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent loss of cryptographic verification and blocking of critical vehicle authentication flows.

threats.threat_description: An attacker exploits vulnerabilities in the HSM firmware or API to gain unauthorized access to cryptographic keys or to generate tokens without proper authorization.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of the Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0027: Exploit Isolated Execution Environment Vulnerability to prevent compromise of cryptographic secrets and unauthorized cryptographic operations.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Firmware and API Security Assessment

threats.threat_description: Manipulation of the crypto engine inside the HSM to bypass verification or generate forged tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0023: Modify Isolated Execution Environment to prevent unauthorized vehicle start and compromise of cryptographic assets.

threats.threat_description: Extraction or leakage of cryptographic keys from the key store within the HSM, which could be used to compromise authentication and authorization tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0028: Hardware Fault Injection to prevent unauthorized forging of authentication and authorization tokens.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering or fault injection attacks on the door lock actuator to force locking or unlocking without valid commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Door ECU -> Actuator Signal and Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized locking or unlocking of the vehicle door.

threats.threat_description: Manipulation of the engine ECU or inverter firmware to bypass start authorization commands and enable engine start without valid tokens.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of the Powertrain Start Interface and Engine Start Command against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Injection of false LF wake/proximity signals by an attacker to the LF receiver, causing the BCM to initiate challenge-response flows unnecessarily.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Authenticity and Availability of the LF Receiver to BCM Event / Control Link against Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unauthorized initiation of BCM authentication flows and associated battery drain.

threats.threat_description: Disruption or jamming of LF receiver signals to prevent detection of the legitimate key fob's proximity, denying access or start authorization.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Availability of the BCM Event / Control Link against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent temporary denial of vehicle access or start authorization for the legitimate user.

threats.threat_description: Relay attacks where an attacker relays RF challenge and response messages between the key fob and vehicle RF antenna to extend the effective range of the key fob and gain unauthorized access or start ability. This spans the Vehicle RF Antenna (ANT_RF_1), RF Transceiver (RF_1), and Key Fob (EXT_1) components, affecting communication assets C2, C10, and related challenge-response messages.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Communication System shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and engine start.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: Vehicle RF Antenna / RF Transceiver / Key Fob (Wireless Interface)

threats.threat_description: Firmware compromise of the RF transceiver (RF_1) or HSM (HSM_1) components that allows an attacker to modify authentication data forwarding, cryptographic verification, or token generation, potentially enabling unauthorized access or start commands. This affects information assets I7, I8, and communication assets C4 and C6.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver and HSM shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of RF Transceiver Firmware, HSM Firmware, and Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent persistent unauthorized vehicle access and bypass of cryptographic protections.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Secure Boot Verification / Firmware Integrity Check

threats.threat_description: Replay attacks where previously captured valid challenge-response messages or tokens are replayed to the BCM or ECUs to gain unauthorized access or start authorization. This affects components BCM_1, ECU_DOOR, ECU_START, and assets C2, I4, C3, and C5.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The BCM_1, ECU_DOOR, and ECU_START shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages and Start Authorization Tokens against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized unlocking and starting of the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Unauthorized access to communication channels and internal buses (e.g., CAN Bus, RF links) allowing an attacker to eavesdrop on sensitive cryptographic messages, tokens, or configuration data across multiple components including BCM, ECUs, and HSM. This affects assets C7 (In-Vehicle CAN), C2 (RF messages), and information assets I1, I4.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The BCM, ECUs, and HSM shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material, Start Authorization Tokens, and RF Challenge-Response Messages against Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle access and operation.

threats.threat_description: Injection of false wake-up signals at the LF front-end (ANT_1, LF_RX_1) or flooding of communication channels (RF_1, CAN Bus) to cause repeated challenge-response cycles or block legitimate authentication flows, leading to battery drain or denial of entry/start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Keyless Entry System shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of LF Proximity Signal, RF Challenge-Response Messages, and In-Vehicle CAN communications against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent denial of entry/start and excessive battery drain.
